title: paper-trading-batch

batch_id.description: Safe batch identifier: 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, starting alphanumeric. The generated batch_id_track_id_mN run ID must fit the separate 128-character match-ID bound; oversized combinations are explicitly rejected before dispatch. Namespaces are planned only. Generated job run IDs use length-prefixed component encoding, not ambiguous underscore concatenation. Namespace plans remain unreserved and future writes/reuse are forbidden until a separate reservation scheme authorizes them.

agents.description: Exactly two unique safe agent names. Only agent-one and agent-two are supported; alternate agents are explicitly rejected, including validation plans. A track may override this pair.

track_id.description: Unique safe track identifier within this batch, at most 64 characters. Used in deterministic run IDs and separate planned account, artifact and strategy namespaces.

interval.description: Exactly 5m, 15m or 1h. CSV timestamps are UTC close times on interval boundaries; closed bars must be unique, ordered and strictly contiguous. Daily relabeling is rejected.

market.description: Nonempty market metadata, at most 64 characters; default tracks use crypto. No market data is fetched or inferred from this label.

symbol.description: Nonempty symbol metadata, at most 128 characters; default tracks use BTC-USD. Filename suffixes or labels do not prove timestamped intraday data.

data_path.description: Exact safe CSV path under /artifacts/trading/market/ or /shared/market/ only. No dot segments, backslashes or glob syntax. Read-only glob/readFile inspection rejects truncation, 10000 or more lines, and files reaching the conservative 2 MiB limit. Exact header: timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume,closed. Conservative exclusive read bounds: UTF-8 file size must be strictly less than 2097152 bytes (2 MiB); total physical lines including header must be strictly less than 10000. Incomplete/truncated or unknown-completeness glob results fail closed.

history_bars.description: Optional per-track override of global history_bars, 10..1000. Includes the decision-start bar; normalized jobs echo the effective value.

bars_per_round.description: Optional per-track override of global bars_per_round, 1..10000. Use overrides to make the shared evaluation duration equal round_count * effective bars_per_round * this interval_ms.

agents.description: Optional per-track override: exactly two unique supported names, agent-one and agent-two. Other names are rejected; normalized jobs echo the effective pair.

tracks.description: One to three tracks with unique track_id values, checked by the code body. Each match/track pair becomes one read-only validation job, at most 30. Use per-track bars_per_round overrides for equal-duration cross-track comparisons.

evaluation_start.description: Required nullable UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. Null produces missing_evaluation_window, not an automatically selected window. Warmup includes history_bars closed bars ending at this decision-start close; evaluation closes are strictly after it.

evaluation_end.description: Required nullable UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. Null blocks validation. Must exceed evaluation_start by exactly round_count * effective bars_per_round * interval_ms. Evaluation closes include this endpoint; the following next-fill close must also be covered.

validation_as_of.description: Required explicit real UTC calendar timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. Evaluation end and the next-fill close must not exceed this cutoff. This caller-supplied value is not trusted wall-clock evidence and cannot authorize execution.

timezone.description: Fixed UTC. Timestamps with offsets, fractional seconds or other time zones are not accepted.

match_count.description: Planned matches per track, 1..10, default 10. With at most three tracks the batch contains at most 30 validation jobs; no actual match is executed.

round_count.description: Planned rounds per match, 1..5, default 5. Determines the required evaluation duration with the effective per-track bars_per_round.

history_bars.description: Global warmup length, 10..1000 closed bars, default 60, including the bar at evaluation_start. A track may override it. Full contiguous warmup coverage is required.

bars_per_round.description: Global closes per planned round, 1..10000, default 7. A track may override it. Required duration is round_count * effective bars_per_round * interval_ms; bounded files may not support large plans.

capital.description: Positive finite initial paper cash per agent, default 1000. Reset policy plans separate accounts per match. Used for reference benchmark arithmetic only; no cash is allocated or traded.

fee_bps.description: Nonnegative finite transaction fee in basis points, default 10; divide by 10000 to obtain the fee rate. Buy-and-hold entry units are capital / (1 + fee_bps/10000) / adjusted entry price. No forced-liquidation exit fee is assumed.

slippage_bps.description: Entry slippage in basis points, at least zero and strictly below 10000, default 5. Reference buy entry price is next_close * (1 + slippage_bps/10000), not a percentage or currency amount.

capital_policy.description: reset or carry, default reset. carry is schema-visible for explicit operator feedback but is unsupported by the current adapter and rejected before dispatch; no carry-capital execution is available.

fill_policy.description: Fixed next_close: the first close after a decision is the reference fill. Coverage includes all evaluation closes and the close immediately following evaluation_end. No actual fills occur.

finalization_policy.description: Fixed mark_to_market. Positions are valued at evaluation_end without forced liquidation or a forced exit fee. This does not execute or close any position.

review_enabled.description: Default true. On the executable paper path this gates the preserved real two-agent between-match strategy review/evidence nodes, separately per track. Validation-only and pre-dispatch blocked runs perform no reviews or review tests.

review_every_matches.description: Per-track between-match review cadence, 1..10 (default 1); review after completed match indices divisible by this value only when another same-track match remains. Disabled reviews bypass the review branch. Actual evidence must pass existing advancement guards.

evidence_required.description: Fixed true. Independent matched replay and a timestamped intraday adapter are required but unavailable; synthetic validation is not real intraday evidence.

bonus_rounds.description: Planned bonus count, 0..3, default 0. Any positive value is unsupported and explicitly rejected; no bonus round or execution occurs.

tie_policy.description: Fixed no_bonus. Ties never authorize bonus rounds or additional execution.

bonus_cash_comparator.description: Fixed zero_return. The cash reference return is zero, not a traded result; it cannot trigger a bonus round.

execution_timeout_seconds.description: Fixed 60-second Code-node limit. This setting cannot be increased to enable execution; actual trading is permanently disabled in this saved implementation.

max_retries.description: Fixed zero. No automatic retries or trading dispatches are performed.

failure_policy.description: Fixed fail_closed. Invalid settings, unverifiable data or missing evidence block progress; no execution fallback is allowed.

validation_only.description: Default true: perform read-only contract/data inspection, bypass every competitor, evidence/review agent and filesystem-write node. False selects the preserved executable paper path only after trusted replay, reservation and data gates succeed; no currently supplied evidence can satisfy replay.

require_matched_replay.description: Default true: trusted independent same-window/cost/fill replay is mandatory before competitor dispatch. No provider/evidence is currently available. False does not authorize bypass. No input flag can fabricate verification.

brief.description: Planning brief, default paper recursive self improvement. Preserved as input text only; it cannot authorize execution, reviews, external calls or strategy changes.

description: Canonical typed paper-competition inputs. Candidate deterministic timestamped next-close settlement is separate from the preserved real A2A competitor/review architecture. Validation-only never dispatches or writes; current non-validation runs are blocked before dispatch by missing independent matched replay and namespace reservation. No synthetic calculation constitutes independent evidence.
